name: PondMud
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.486

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven brown_mud_03 and brown_mud_02 (2x2 each, shifted) height-blended; hollows are wetter (lower roughness, darker)
known_weaknesses: no standing-water film or reeds; the 1.3 m period of both scans can be found at 4x4
